items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: We’d do “Now is the Time” and oh just Bird and Diz tunes.

ctx.x: What would your songlist have consisted of them? Kinds of tunes?
Oh we would do bebop then. We’d were beboppers. We’d do “Now is the Time” and oh just Bird and Diz tunes.
